page_title: SAL 1-2 JUV | Salernitana v Juventus 07/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+6' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
90+5' Marco Guida blows his whistle and it's Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90+4' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
90+3' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
90+2' It's like he was asking for a caution. Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) receives a yellow card.

90+1' 1 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Danilo sends a superb cross into the box. Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) latches on to it and from near the penalty spot powers a header low inside the right post, leaving Benoit Costil beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:2.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) receives the ball from Weston McKennie and tries to beat the keeper from long range, but the effort goes high over the bar.
89' Agustin Martegani (Salernitana) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Junior Sambia.
87' Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
85' Weston McKennie (Juventus) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
81' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to substitute Timothy Weah and he is replaced by Joseph Nonge Boende (Juventus).
80' Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) comes onto the pitch for Simy.
77' Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
77' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
76' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

76' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear. The ball goes out for a corner. Juventus can continue in their attacking effort.
75' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area. Juventus force their opponents to concede a corner.
73' This is a yellow card! Daniele Rugani (Juventus) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
72' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Benoit Costil, who smothers the ball.
71' Weston McKennie (Juventus) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
70' Simy (Salernitana) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the left post.
69' Weston McKennie (Juventus) will miss the next game.
69' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Weston McKennie (Juventus) is given a yellow card.
68' Substitution. Fabio Miretti (Juventus) replaces Kenan Yildiz.
68' Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
67' Wojciech Szczesny blocks a long-range effort from Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) towards the right side of the goal.
65' 1 - 1 Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) has a great chance inside the box and slams the ball into the top right corner.

64' Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) produces a long-range cannon of a shot after a nice pass. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but is easily stopped by a save from Benoit Costil and the score remains the same.
61' The ball spins to Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) on the edge of the box. He hits across the ball and sends it goalwards, but it goes just wide of the left post.
59' Here's the change. Hans Nicolussi Caviglia leaves the pitch and Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) comes on as a substitute.
58' Timothy Weah plays a short lofted pass to Kenan Yildiz (Juventus), whose header from the centre of the box drifts well past the left post.
57' Filippo Inzaghi makes a tactical change due to a red card. Dylan Bronn (Salernitana) comes on in place of Loum Tchaouna.
54' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Juventus) fails to direct the ball into the net from the resulting set piece. His effort goes well wide of the left post. Such a squandered chance!
54' Juventus are awarded a free kick on the edge of the box.
53' The match has ended for Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) as he picks up his second yellow card and referee Marco Guida pulls out a red card!
51' PENALTY APPEAL after Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

49' Adrien Rabiot sends a lovely lofted pass forward that flies over the top of the defence and into the path of Weston McKennie (Juventus), but he can't direct his header on target as it flies well wide of the right post.
48' Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
46' Massimiliano Allegri makes a half-time substitution. Daniele Rugani comes on in place of Federico Gatti (Juventus).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Massimiliano Allegri probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Filip Kostic (Juventus). He is replaced by Samuel Iling Junior.
46' Referee Marco Guida blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
43' Federico Gatti (Juventus) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
43' Marco Guida shows a yellow card to Federico Gatti (Juventus) for his blatant foul.
42' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Juventus) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
41' Filippo Inzaghi is stunned as referee Marco Guida shows him a yellow card. What was that for?

39' 1 - 0 Goal! Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) neatly controls a decent pass from Loum Tchaouna. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the left side of the goal from the edge of the box. 1:0.
38' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
37' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Junior Sambia (Salernitana). The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Salernitana.
36' Foul! Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
32' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Juventus was in an offside position.
32' Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) has tested the patience of referee Marco Guida and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

32' A rebound on the edge of the box falls to the feet of the unmarked Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Juventus). He doesn't hesitate and shoots towards goal, but unfortunately for him it hits one of his own teammates.
31' Juventus seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
30' Total attempts – 2:2. The number of shots on goal at present is 1:0.
25' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Juventus) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
24' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Juventus) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first. Juventus will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
21' Weston McKennie (Juventus) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
19' Booking. Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana) receives a caution from the referee.
19' The ball rebounds to Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he bends the ball well wide of the left post.
18' One of the players from Juventus times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
16' Salernitana are seeing far more of the ball now.
13' Filip Kostic (Juventus) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
12' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Juventus.

9' What a great chance for Weston McKennie (Juventus). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
9' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Juventus).
9' Danilo (Juventus) glances on a header from the corner sent into the near post, but his close-range effort is blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
8' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Juventus) will take a corner kick.

8' Timothy Weah (Juventus) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The ball is out of play. Juventus win a corner kick.

6' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Juventus) sends a long ball forward to Adrien Rabiot, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball has crossed the sideline. Salernitana are taking a throw-in.
4' Junior Sambia (Salernitana) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the bottom right corner, but Wojciech Szczesny pulls off a fantastic save to deny him.
2' Filip Kostic (Juventus) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
2' Timothy Weah (Juventus) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball goes behind for a corner. Juventus will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
1' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
1' The first half has started.
Salernitana will kick the game off.
Marco Guida is introduced as the referee for today's match.
